newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq condemns U.S. veto over Israeli plan, paper.
newsitem.headline: Iraq condemns U.S. veto over Israeli plan, paper.

text.p: The ruling Baath party newspaper al-Thawra on Sunday condemned the United States for vetoing a Security Council resolution calling on Israel not to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
"The United States veto...reveals how Washington is irresponsible toward international laws and the United Nations' charter," the newspaper said.

The Security Council vote late on Friday was 14 in favour, with only the United States voting against. As one of the council's five permanent members, its vote killed the resolution, drafted by Britain, France, Portugal and Sweden.
"What will the United States gain from its hostile policy against the Arabs?," Thawra asked.
"The recent American veto should wake up all souls which forget that the Arabs have rights and that their lives and very existence are threatened," it said.
